source_values.cell: 75 mm long cylindrical 133Cs cell, 4 mm inner diameter, 5 Torr N2 buffer gas
source_values.operation: signal pulse 10 ns, control pulse 25 ns, control peak power 5 mW, red detuning 1.5 GHz, cell temp 75 C
source_values.note: Pulse durations and one-photon detuning are not currently consumed by ExperimentalParams/SimParams, so they are kept here as notes.

notes.important: Current config_object.build_cloud() ignores any top-level cloud section. It builds a random cylinder with R = simulation_window_radius_w0_cutoff * exp.w0_control and Lz = exp.Lz.
notes.sim_density_note: The sim.sim_density below is the physical Cs vapor density converted to code units for scalling=1. This is faithful as a template but will generate billions of atoms in the 3*w0 interaction window. Downsample sim_density before running if needed.
